title: Hot Fishes In Your Area
description: On the topic of hooks, did you know you could fish in lava? It's not particularly easy, but if you've got [the right hook made up of some obsidian and gold](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/lavaproof_hook.png:124:62), you can find some very unique fish. The best place for this would be The Nether, but even lava in the overworld will house some species.
